# titer

> An instrument for measuring how often commercial people-search indexes
> confidently resolve the wrong human, and what it is worth paying to find out.
> Ground truth is an SEC filing, not a model's judgement.

Status: published. E1 and E3 measured on verified negatives; two formal
retractions; five of six headline numbers were artefacts of this instrument.
`MEASUREMENT_CARD.json` reads PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and is generated, not written.

## Core

- [CONTRACTS](CONTRACTS.md): frozen definitions — attestation tiers, the attested
  tuple, closed taxonomies, outcome classes, cost profiles, reward, splits.
- [PRE-REGISTRATION](docs/PRE-REGISTRATION.md): hypotheses H1-H4 with
  falsification conditions, estimators, and the pre-committed power rule. Never
  edited; superseded only by dated DECISIONS entries.
- [METHOD](docs/METHOD.md): why a filing and not a judge; why cost and not
  accuracy; where a model is allowed to act.
- [ARCHITECTURE](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and seams.
- [DECISIONS](docs/DECISIONS.md): append-only decision log, D001-D020.

## Honesty surface

- [COVERAGE](docs/COVERAGE.md): what this cannot see, in PeopleSearchBench's
  vocabulary rather than ours.
- [RED-TEAM](docs/RED-TEAM.md): 11 attacks on our own claims; 4 carried as LIVE.
- [RETRACTIONS](docs/RETRACTIONS.md): empty, on purpose.
- [RUBRIC](docs/RUBRIC.md): self-score, with the unavailable points named.
- [ETHICS](docs/ETHICS.md): pointers not records; no contact fields ever;
  rectification within 7 days.

## Operations

- [WAVES](docs/WAVES.md), [HANDOFF](docs/HANDOFF.md),
  [REPRODUCTION](docs/REPRODUCTION.md), [SURVEY](docs/SURVEY.md),
  [LINEAGE](docs/LINEAGE.md), [BENCHMARK](docs/BENCHMARK.md)
